title: Flying mounts: round 3 variations
desc: Three new variations each of 841's winged horse (F1a), comet horse (F1c), blocky glider (F2c) and the three real-size ghast constructs (F3a shell, F3b cage, F3c strata), same textures, each built and flown a different way.

takes.name: winged horse: fan wings, R2 K1
takes.facts: nine slats fan open on one hub; crouch and spring take-off on one big stroke, then a climbing circle to 9 blocks

takes.name: winged horse: four wings, R2 K1
takes.facts: fore and hind feather wings beat out of phase, fast; never stops galloping, runs up the air in three surges to 7.8

takes.name: winged horse: Z-fold wings, R2 K1
takes.facts: three-joint wings with covert, secondary and primary feathers unfold from a Z; one huge stroke at 48-60, then soars an S-turn with two trim flaps

takes.name: comet horse: comet tail, H1
takes.facts: one lathe body running into a 1.6-block ringed comet tail, hind legs fold into it; climbs to 7, a barrel roll at 66-86, flakes stream from the tail tip

takes.name: comet horse: ring slices, H1
takes.facts: body built of eleven separate slices with sky between; a few strides, then a helix climb 1.5 turns to 10 blocks; light ribbons from the hooves

takes.name: comet horse: one-piece hull, H1
takes.facts: single smooth hull to a pointed rear, neck fins; three bounding leaps with hex shock rings, then a dive and climb out; hex-plate flakes

takes.name: blocky glider: voxel-grid wings, H1
takes.facts: each wing a 6 x 3 grid of loose cubes on six span joints, the flap runs out as a wave; runs on all fours, launches, circles a thermal up to 8

takes.name: blocky glider: folding panels, H1
takes.facts: five hinged H1 panels per wing, zigzag-packed, snap flat; a construct pillar lifts it 4.5, it dives off, pulls into a glide, the pillar breaks

takes.name: blocky glider: stepped delta, H1
takes.facts: rigid stepped pixel-art delta wings and a tail fin; hovers up 3 on quick beats, darts forward, a 70-degree wingover turn

takes.name: ghast shell: rounded cube, R2 K1
takes.facts: one smooth rounded-cube shell 0.26 off the skin, cone sleeves; breathes 3%, rises 3, glides out with a sway

takes.name: ghast shell: banded double shell, R2 K1
takes.facts: thin snug inner shell plus five barrel bands, three bands per sleeve; lifts to 6, turns in two clean 30-degree steps

takes.name: ghast shell: chamfered, R2 K1
takes.facts: one chamfered gem-cut shell, quarter-twisted square sleeves, rider rail; strafes 4 sideways while rising, swings round and climbs

takes.name: ghast cage: round rods, W1
takes.facts: 3 x 3 windows of round rods with a glowing ball at every crossing, coil-spring tentacles; three lift pulses to 6, then a slow turn

takes.name: ghast cage: diamond lattice, W1
takes.facts: diagonal diamond lattice inside a frame glowing on all 12 edges, square-frame tentacle stacks; five pulses that zigzag left and right

takes.name: ghast cage: gimbal ring, W1
takes.facts: fine 3 x 3 cage plus a 4.3 m equator ring that turns with six beads, lantern-tube tentacles; rises to 6 in a climbing corkscrew

takes.name: ghast strata: front-to-back slices, BR1
takes.facts: five slices stacked front to back, all 12 edges of each glow, breathing apart along the body; a straight ramp climb to 6

takes.name: ghast strata: twisting slabs, BR1
takes.facts: three thick slabs that breathe by twisting 4 degrees opposite ways, 12 glowing edges each; rises 5, turns right round, heads back

takes.name: ghast strata: stepped skirt, BR1
takes.facts: four tiers widening downward (an upside-down ziggurat), 12 glowing edges each, brick-ring sleeves; rises 7 through a wide banked S
